parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) offers the Premium Interior Design Package for apartments, private houses, and commercial spaces where a highly detailed interior design project, an extended set of technical documentation, and professional support during preparation for implementation are required.

The package combines space-planning solutions, photorealistic 3D visualizations, a complete set of essential technical drawings, wall elevations for all rooms, detailed construction nodes and sections, specifications, and calculations of key materials.
The package also includes two joint visits with the designer for the selection of finishing materials.
Premium is suitable for projects where implementation accuracy, detailed development of solutions, and reducing the number of questions during renovation are especially important.
What Is Included in the Premium Package
1. Measured Floor Plan
Before the design process begins, the main dimensions of the property, walls, window and door openings, utilities, and other architectural elements are recorded.
The measured floor plan becomes the basis for space planning, technical documentation, and 3D visualization.
2. Furniture Layout Plan
A functional layout is developed with the placement of furniture, plumbing fixtures, and the main interior elements.
Room dimensions, circulation, ergonomics, storage systems, and everyday use scenarios are taken into account.
3. Demolition and Construction Plans
If required, drawings are prepared showing the demolition of existing structures and the construction of new partitions.
This allows the construction team to clearly understand the scope and sequence of the required works.
4. Plumbing Layout Plan
The exact positions of plumbing fixtures and the required engineering connections are defined.
Bathrooms, kitchens, laundry rooms, and other areas requiring plumbing connections are carefully planned.
5. Underfloor Heating Plan
If required, an underfloor heating layout is developed taking into account furniture, plumbing fixtures, and the specific features of the floor plan.
6. Sockets and Electrical Outlets Plan
A layout of sockets, electrical outlets, and appliance connection points is developed.
Electrical planning takes into account the future placement of furniture, kitchen equipment, televisions, work areas, and other appliances.
7. Switches Plan
The locations of switches and the main lighting control scenarios are defined.
This makes lighting more convenient to use and allows all necessary electrical points to be planned in advance.
8. Lighting Plan
A layout of the main and decorative light sources is developed.
The project may include ceiling lights, track lighting, pendant lights, wall lights, LED lighting, and other solutions.
9. Ceiling Plan
A ceiling layout is developed taking into account lighting, built-in elements, and the architecture of the space.
10. Flooring Plan
The types and boundaries of flooring materials, laying directions, and transitions between materials are defined.
This allows parquet, engineered wood, tiles, porcelain stoneware, and other finishes to be coordinated in advance.
11. Wall Elevations for All Rooms
The Premium Package includes extended wall elevations for more detailed interior development.
The elevations may show furniture, plumbing fixtures, tiles, decorative panels, sockets, lighting fixtures, built-in elements, and other important details.
12. Detailed Construction Nodes and Sections
Additional nodes, sections, and detail drawings are prepared for complex interior solutions.
They help the construction team accurately implement non-standard structures and technically complex interior elements.
13. Specifications and Key Material Calculations
The project includes specifications and information on the main finishing materials provided for in the approved concept.
This helps determine the required items in advance and simplifies preparation for procurement and project implementation.
Photorealistic 3D Visualization of Each Room
Photorealistic 3D visualizations are developed for each main room.
They allow you to see the future interior in advance and evaluate the combination of materials, furniture, lighting, colors, textiles, and decorative elements.
At the visualization stage, the appearance of the future space can be carefully approved before renovation begins.
The Premium Package includes up to two rounds of revisions to the developed concept.
Extended Technical Documentation
One of the main differences of the Premium Package is the higher level of technical detail.

In addition to the standard working drawings, the project includes extended wall elevations, nodes, sections, specifications, and additional information required for accurate implementation of complex interior solutions.
This is especially important for projects with custom-made furniture, decorative wall panels, non-standard ceiling structures, complex material junctions, and a large number of built-in elements.
The more detailed the technical documentation, the fewer decisions need to be made directly on site during renovation.
Two Designer Visits for Material Selection
The package includes two joint visits with the designer for the selection of finishing materials.
During these visits, real samples of tiles, flooring, paint, decorative materials, and other interior elements can be reviewed and coordinated.
This helps bring the final implementation as close as possible to the approved 3D visualizations and reduces the risk of unsuccessful material combinations on site.
What Types of Properties Is the Premium Package Suitable For?
The package is suitable for apartments in new developments, resale properties, private houses, investment properties, offices, beauty salons, shops, showrooms, and other commercial spaces.
It is particularly suitable for properties with complex architecture, a large amount of built-in furniture, non-standard finishing solutions, and high requirements for implementation quality.
Each project is developed individually, taking into account the architecture of the property, its size, function, budget, and the client’s requirements.
Who Is the Premium Package For?

The package is recommended if you need a highly detailed interior design project, comprehensive technical documentation for the construction team, a large number of custom solutions, or if you want to minimize the number of questions that arise during renovation.
It is also suitable if detailed material development, greater flexibility for visual revisions, and professional designer support during the selection of finishing materials are important to you.
Premium is an optimal solution for projects where implementation quality and accurate correspondence with the approved concept are a priority.
What You Receive

As a result, you receive a thoroughly developed interior design project including functional space planning, furniture layout, photorealistic 3D visualizations, an extended set of technical drawings, wall elevations, construction nodes, sections, specifications, and calculations of key materials.
The package also includes up to two rounds of revisions to the visual concept and two joint visits with the designer for the selection of finishing materials.
The project becomes a detailed guide for interior implementation and helps the construction team follow the approved concept as accurately as possible.
Premium Interior Design Package Price
€50/m²
Minimum package price — €2,500.
The final price depends on the size of the property, number of rooms, complexity of the architectural and interior solutions, and the amount of technical documentation required.
How Is Premium Different from the Basic Package?
The Basic Package includes the main set of technical drawings and provides a complete interior design project for renovation.

Premium offers a deeper level of project development: additional wall elevations, nodes and sections, extended specifications and material calculations, up to two rounds of visualization revisions, and two joint visits with the designer for the selection of finishing materials.

If the property is technically complex or it is especially important to implement the developed interior as accurately as possible, the Premium Package provides a higher level of preparation for renovation works.
Additional Services

If required, the Premium Package can be supplemented with design supervision, a detailed renovation cost estimate, project procurement, furniture, lighting and decor selection, custom furniture design, production of kitchens, wardrobes, walk-in closets and other built-in furniture, delivery and installation, as well as turnkey renovation.
This makes it possible to continue working with one contractor after the design stage and move directly to the implementation of the interior.
Interior Design in Bratislava and Vienna

DUMSKAYA DESIGN works with residential and commercial properties, combining interior design, photorealistic visualization, technical documentation, custom-made furniture, and complete project implementation.
The studio’s main geographic focus is Bratislava and Vienna. We also work on projects in other cities across Europe and the USA.

If you need a highly detailed interior design project with extended technical documentation and additional designer support during preparation for renovation, the Premium Package provides a high level of development at every stage of the project.
